doc: Reel style 'list' (reference trait: a near-black stage, a UI-font title pinned at the top, a teleprompter list that scrolls one line per entry with the active line bright, cards crossfading in the middle).

reel.summary: near-black canvas, UI title pinned at the top, scrolling list (active line bright), clip/insets crossfading below it

title.doc: title pinned at the top for the whole reel

items.doc: the list entries, one per line (null = the spoken words, one per line)

at_ms.doc: when each entry becomes active, ms (null = spread over the take)

inset1.doc: inset 1: the index of an image in the `images` input (0 is the first), or 'none' for no inset

inset1_t.doc: when inset 1 shows: {in_ms, out_ms} on the source timeline (the reel command spreads them over the take)
